data-query.check.connectFailed: Can't connect. Check the host, port, account and password.

data-query.check.privilegesHint: Only USAGE, SELECT and SHOW VIEW are allowed; role grants aren't allowed either. Use a read-only account, or ask a DBA to revoke the privileges above and test again.
data-query.check.sessionReadOnly: Connection set to READ ONLY; multi-statements and local file loading are disabled
data-query.check.skipped: Skipped because the previous step failed

data-query.columns.autoHint: Added automatically from the body's SELECT or trial results; becomes a manual declaration once edited
data-query.columns.label: Title
data-query.columns.name: Column

data-query.constraints.countAllowedHint: Runs an extra COUNT that shares the main query's timeout
data-query.constraints.cursorColumnsHint: 1–{max} columns; the body must write its own {tag} condition and ORDER BY
data-query.constraints.pagingModeHint: LIMIT is appended by the service; don't write a top-level LIMIT in the body

data-query.dataSource.saveGate.testRequi: This data source is enabled: after changes, test the connection and pass before saving.
data-query.dataSource.status.disableNoti: Once disabled, templates that use it can't run; queries in progress finish normally.

data-query.dataSources.count: {count, plural, one {# data source} other {# data sources}}

data-query.editor.maxPoolSizeHint: 1–{max}; connections open on demand and are released after 10 minutes idle
data-query.editor.name: Name
